Initial release of phy-pre-commit-gen — a .pre-commit-config.yaml generator that tailors hooks to your codebase.

- Analyzes project files to detect languages (Python, JS/TS, Go, Rust, Terraform, Docker, Shell, SQL) and tool configs
- Auto-selects appropriate pre-commit hooks (e.g., Ruff vs Black, ESLint, Prettier) depending on your stack and configs
- Includes base hooks for code quality, secrets detection, Markdown linting, and more
- Features an audit mode to identify unpinned hook revisions and missing critical hooks in existing configs
- Outputs valid YAML, does not overwrite configs unless specified, and requires only the Python standard library
